snippet.title: Wonderfall - Official Extended Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at the Extended Reveal Trailer for Wonderfall, an atmospheric third-person adventure game developed by Attaboy Interactive. Players will explore a 1920s Paris on the brink of sinking into the depths of sand. Manipulate the sands, embark on a narrative-driven tale, and seek the truth of the city's affliction. Wonderfall is coming soon to PC (Steam).
